note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Missed a third launch deadline (industry expected it ~Jul 17); reportedly short on coding/reasoning in testing, no model card or specs published. Google is weighing a stopgap release over the full Pro.
Polymarket's dated GPT-6 market runs ~90% by Dec 31 and ~75% by Sep 30; OpenAI's line still flows through the GPT-5.6 family (public Jul 9), keeping the numbered flagship a second-half story.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~99% by Oct 31 (98% by Dec), though the exact version is unannounced.

xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term (~8% before Aug, ~16% before Sep). The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, with public access likely slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is reportedly targeted for Jul 24 2026, per DeepSeek's developer notes.
